title: Korat Marathon 2026 Review: Nakhon Ratchasima's Full Marathon with Open Registration
seo_title: Korat Marathon 2026 Review | Nakhon Ratchasima Thailand Race
meta_description: The Korat Marathon 2026: November 8 in Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand. Full marathon, half, 10K, and 5K with registration open — Isan's gateway-city marathon reviewed.
dek: Set for 8 November 2026 in Nakhon Ratchasima (Korat) — the gateway to Isan — this marathon offers four distances with registration open. A high-confidence northeast Thailand road race.
verdict: The Korat Marathon brings a four-distance format to Nakhon Ratchasima — Thailand's second-largest province and the gateway to the Isan region — with registration open and a high reliability score of 86. Korat's flat terrain, its role as a transport hub (direct trains and buses from Bangkok), and November's cooling temperatures make this an accessible, bookable northeast Thailand marathon. A solid regional pick for runners who want an authentic Isan race experience with open registration.

sections.heading: Korat: Isan's Gateway
paragraphs: Nakhon Ratchasima (Korat) is the largest province in Thailand and the historic gateway to the Isan region, roughly 3 hours from Bangkok. [1] The city is flat, spread across the Khorat Plateau, with wide roads that support a fast marathon course. November is the onset of the cool season — morning temperatures dropping into the low 20s.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A well-structured Isan marathon with open registration. 8 November 2026 in Nakhon Ratchasima. Register via koratmarathon.com. [1]
